name: Safebox Display
description: Read a password from the 16-key keypad (8 lines across 4 rows and 4 columns). The password is "1234"; when the entered keys match, energize the active high relay to unlock the safebox. Also display the entered password on the first row of the LCD1602 as "Input: %s" (the four entered keys, e.g. "Input: 1234"), and on the second row exactly "Status: Success" if the password matches or exactly "Status: Fail" if it does not. After the fourth key the result stays on the display until the next key press, which starts a new four-key entry.
